snippet.title: Creature Feature | Cursed 80s Arcade Bullet Heaven | Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Creature Feature is a bullet heaven trapped inside a cursed 80s arcade cartridge. The sprites move when they shouldn't. And the game remembers what you did last run.

Endless weapon combinations and evolutions, 7 characters with unique abilities, a full ARPG loot system with 60 unique items, a deep persistent skill tree, 4 maps, 6 difficulty modes, and a corruption system that watches you play.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4505460/Creature_Feature/
Discord: https://discord.gg/ZRFjAFRYKS
Twitter: https://x.com/CreatureFeatur_
